description: quotaExhaustedLabel: usage windows ({label, used} with used as a 0..1 ratio) -> status label, or null when nothing is exhausted. A label 'Pool · Window' belongs to that pool; a label without ' · ' belongs to the whole account. A window is exhausted at used >= 1. Any exhausted account-wide window, or every pool exhausted, -> 'Quota exhausted'. Otherwise the exhausted pools in order, joined with ', ', + ' quota exhausted' (e.g. 'Gemini quota exhausted'). The pool used for chip emphasis is the same: a chip is 'exhausted' (amber) only when its pool is at 100%.
